results.title: Niger, Mali and Burkina Faso resume dialogue with ECOWAS regional bloc - France 24
results.snippet:
Issued on:

Three junta-ruled Sahel states – Niger, Mali and Burkina Faso – on Saturday resumed dialogue with the ECOWAS regional bloc, which they withdrew from more than 18 months ago. They agreed to work towards a “framework agreement” on cooperation. FRANCE 24’s regional correspondent Harold Girard tells us more.
